input.task: What does the second heading on this page say?

provenance: T-M40-2-4's exact cold-review repro, after T-M40-5 confirmed the same family live on x-rates.com (runs 110e9e8f and 48b60ee3). Plan 1 is correctly refused because WebArea is the document root. The replan changes only the locator tier, copies the root's page-title name into a loose text target, resolves it onto the h1 and reports `success` / `Hello Fixture` with every verifier check green, although the task asks for a nonexistent second heading. The strategy did not change; only the spelling of the same forbidden target did.

triage.note: The fix must be site-agnostic: stop advertising the unaddressable root and refuse a pre-execution replan that retargets its same name without an addressable role. A model may still invent WebArea, so observation cleanup alone is not a guard.
